mapper.select: SELECT * FROM community WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE community SET member_count = member_count + #{delta}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND #{delta} IN (-1, 1) AND member_count + #{delta} BETWEEN 1 AND 1000

UPDATE community SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, badge = #{badge}, visibility = #{visibility}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND version = #{expectedVersion}
